title: oldenlandia corymbosa var. uniflora
intro: Oldenlandia corymbosa var. uniflora, commonly known as Asian Swampweed or Asian Swamp Cress, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia corymbosa var. uniflora include analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
